END, [t].[AssignedAt], [t].[TaskID], [t].[AssigneeUserID], [t1].[AssigneeUserID], [t1].[TaskID]
FROM [TaskAssignments] AS [t]
INNER JOIN [Tasks] AS [t0] ON [t].[TaskID] = [t0].[TaskID]
LEFT JOIN [TaskAssignments] AS [t1] ON [t0].[TaskID] = [t1].[TaskID]
WHERE [t].[AssigneeUserID] = @__userId_0 AND [t0].[Deadline] IS NOT NULL AND [t0].[Deadline] >= @__start_1 AND [t0].[Deadline] <= @__end_2
ORDER BY [t0].[Deadline], [t].[TaskID], [t].[AssigneeUserID], [t0].[TaskID], [t1].[TaskID]
